Fortunate or unfortunate side effect of canyoning noise like this. Overall it makes stream depth more consistent, but canyons look good in some areas and lame in others.

If you crank the noise way up, you can get something like this on the banks.
The noise is now bound to the banks, not the valley like this old pic.
Theres definitely a lot of potential for unique streams by editing these bank noise configs.
Caps how deep the streambed can carve below sea level, so any depth of stream fades to the same mouth depth.

The Coastal Erosion slope creates good terrain for streams to path upwards. Basegame terrain is quite flat over long distances, which rarely creates good slopes for long streams.
